subcategory_text: Establish a unified application-security strategy aligned with the organisation's business objectives, with measurable goals and risk-based prioritisation.
implementation_examples: L1: Document application-security goals and link them to business risks
L2: Define measurable AppSec KPIs and publish a dashboard
L3: Re-align strategy annually based on threat-landscape and KPI trends
assessment_objectives: Determine whether an AppSec strategy exists and is approved.
Determine whether the strategy has measurable goals.
